reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. A named lab and a batch report is nice, but I would need a reason to change what already works for me.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A report on a product page is something the brand itself posts, and I have never heard of this brand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my current brand fail an independent test, or a creator I already trust showing the same lab report for this batch and saying it worked for them.
